{{Quote|Looking for a new Starfighter? You've come to the right place! You will surely be satisfied with these!|GL1-D3|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''GL1-D3''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|vendor droid]] found in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The droid sold [[Delta-7 Aethersprite-class light interceptor/Legends|Jedi Starfighters]].

==Behind the scenes==
The droid's name is a reference to the word "glide".
